chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman in her late twenties wearing a burgundy velvet house kaftan with gold trim, a loose cream headscarf slipping back off her dark hair, gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 20 wearing a mustard yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans, short curly black hair, thin moustache

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a simple Moroccan village house salon with low sedari couches and a dim lamp. WIFE sits alone on the couch, caught looking up in surprise toward the doorway, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible. In the foreground edge, NARRATOR seen from behind at the doorway holding a box of Moroccan pastries. Subjects centered, calm background at the edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same night salon. NARRATOR bends down and kisses WIFE on the forehead to apologise, holding the pastry box in his other hand; WIFE sits still with eyes lowered. Medium shot, both faces visible, subjects centered, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same night salon. NARRATOR stands with his hand on his chest saying sorry, ashamed expression; WIFE on the couch looks up at him silently. Medium shot, both faces visible, subjects centered, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same night salon. WIFE has stood up and hugs NARRATOR tightly, her cheek on his shoulder; NARRATOR stands stiff and awkward, eyes wide and uneasy, looking past her shoulder. Medium shot, both faces visible, subjects centered, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same night salon, close medium shot. WIFE with teary glistening eyes starts crying, still holding NARRATOR's arm; NARRATOR looks down at her confused and uncomfortable. Both faces visible, subjects centered, no text.
